name: CauliflowerBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a cauliflower coral structure. The object shows the raw geometry of clustered, rounded lobes that together form the compact mass characteristic of cauliflower coral. Without any texture or material color applied, the white mesh clearly exposes how multiple smooth blob-like volumes are packed together and stacked, with a wavy, lobed lower skirt at the base. A soft shadow beneath grounds the object on the white background.
